packet-16 - isolated first reading (unverified image reading)
No proposed identification was present in my context. Did nothing beyond the rules.

LAYOUT SURVEY (image-001 overview, face 1)
- Two separate paper leaves photographed side by side, upright, on black ground with colour chart. Pencil labels at foot of each leaf (modern): left leaf "Stams, STA, Fg. 229-2v"(?), right leaf "Stams, STA, Fg. 229-1r"(?) (readings of labels tentative).
- Not a literary text: these are account lists in German cursive (Kurrent) of the 17th-c. type: single column of item names at left, dotted leaders, sums at right in two sub-columns (apparently gulden : kreuzer). No running titles, no rubrics, no glosses. Large flourished initials (looped capitals) at the start of the list blocks.
- Left leaf: a column of ~9 items with sums (heading at top right "fl" ?), then a ruled line, then a heading in two lines ("... Amm(?) ... / ... 17. Wochen, A(nn)o 1645"(?)), then ~22 items, many prefixed with a numeral "1" or "2" at the left edge, and some struck/underlined.
- Right leaf: heading "Die 48 Wochen"(?) at top, then ~35 items with sums; from about mid-page many items are underscored with long horizontal strokes running to the sum column. Final line a "Su(mma)"-like flourish.
- Tiles image-002..005 appear to be the native-resolution quadrants of this face.

CORRECTION (made with image-003 and image-005 both still in view): image-003 lines 17 and 18 ("Schreiblohn(?)" and "Ziegellohn(?)") are one and the same physical line; I double-counted. The sequence on the leaf is: Pfannenmaister(?) 4:12 / S?emberg(?) —:18 / Holzbrod(?) 1:20 / Gießelch(?) —:18 / Tremmer(?) 11:—. (Sums sit slightly above the baseline of their item, which caused the slip.) So 005.02 —:18 belongs to S?emberg and 005.03 1:20 to Holzbrod, as written in image-005; 005.04's first alternative "Ziegellohn" should be dropped in favour of "Gießelch(?)" [word uncertain].

- Same two leaves, other sides (labels "Stams, STA, Fig.(?) 229-2v" left, "229-1v" right). Heavy reddish-purple staining/splashes across both leaves obscure parts of the text.
- Left leaf: top block of ~9 entries with leading numerals, then a ruled line, then heading "Die 18 Wochen A(nn)o 45"(?) with column head "fl kr"(?), then ~30 entries.
